entries.zh: 有产业；置有田宅、家产恒业
entries.en: to have real property/estate; to own land and possessions (17c Spanish bienes raíces, "good roots" = immovable property)
entries.notes: 西语 rayces 有[疑:rayces/rayes]，推断为 bienes raíces（不动产）之残写，与汉字「产业」正合。

entries.zh: 牵挽；拉曳、牵引
entries.en: to pull; to drag; to draw
entries.notes: 西语词头残损难辨（jeljaho o di nario），释义依汉字「牵挽」而定。

entries.zh: 想要说话；有开口之意
entries.en: to feel like speaking; to have the urge to talk
entries.notes: 西语残（g[残]anos 推断为 ganas de hablar），汉字「到使」与西义对应未详。

entries.zh: 温饱；衣食饱暖、生计无缺
entries.en: to be warm and well-fed; to have food and clothing enough
entries.notes: 西语词头残损（[残]ado elgaro），释义依汉字「温饱」而定。

entries.zh: 缺少；犹有所缺
entries.en: to lack; to fall short (Spanish frame: "to have what is necessary, but to lack...")
entries.notes: 西语多处残损，汉字作「缺火」疑为「缺少」残字，语义未能定夺。

entries.zh: 开沟；挖掘沟渠
entries.en: to dig/open a ditch or channel (Spanish column reads tener vagar "to have leisure", probably a misreading of cavar)
entries.notes: 音写 cuy 有[疑:cuy/uy]，且西语 vagar（有闲暇）与「开沟」不合，疑为 cavar（挖掘）之误读或栏目错位。

entries.zh: 相通；互通声气、互有往来
entries.en: to correspond/communicate; to have mutual understanding and dealings (inteligencia y trato)
entries.notes: 西语 trap 有[疑:trap/trato]，当为 trato（往来、交易），与「相通」相合。

entries.zh: 抵物；物抵（底）于器中〔西语示例残疑，对合未详〕
entries.en: to have things laid/stored in the vessel (Spanish column appears to be the example "to have garlic in the pot"; correspondence unresolved)
entries.notes: 西语 alos 有[疑:alos/ajos]且系示例句，与「抵物」字义难以对合，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 事情已定、经手交割清楚〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to have a matter firmly settled and handed over [damaged original; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 西语与汉字均有残缺（agido/consol[残]；定[残]過手），仅据残存「定…過手」与西语框架推断。

entries.zh: 得人钱钞；有钱，自他人处得钱钞在手
entries.en: to have money; to hold cash received from others (lit. "to get people's money")

entries.zh: 有起倒；钱财足用而有起落（丰歉无常）
entries.en: to have money enough, in highs and lows; ups and downs of fortune

entries.zh: 有根节；有心识、明事理
entries.en: to have understanding/sense; to be discerning (lit. "to have root and node")

entries.zh: 怀抱病人；抱坐于怀中
entries.en: to hold the sick person in one's arms, seated in one's lap
entries.notes: 首字有[疑:掽/捧]，依西语「抱病者于怀」取「捧抱」义；「塊坐」连读作「抱坐」。

entries.zh: 充用；用度齐备、所需皆有
entries.en: to have everything needed for use; to be adequately supplied
entries.notes: 首字有[疑:克/充]，依原稿音写 chiong 定为「充」。

entries.zh: 充足；所需俱足、无有匮乏
entries.en: to have everything necessary; to be fully supplied
entries.notes: 首字有[疑:克/充]，依原稿音写 chiong 定为「充」。

entries.zh: 享用；备物齐整，坐享其用
entries.en: to enjoy the use of what one has; to be provided for and enjoy it

entries.zh: 充裕；宽绰有余
entries.en: to have ample means; to be well provided
entries.notes: 首字有[疑:克/充]，依原稿音写 chiong、xu 对读定为「充裕」。

entries.zh: 充盛；丰盈盛足
entries.en: to have abundance in full flourish; to be richly provided
entries.notes: 首字有[疑:克/充]，依原稿音写 chiong 定为「充」。

entries.zh: 福德；有福泽荫庇，故所需皆备
entries.en: to have blessings and merit, and hence all that is needed
entries.notes: 音写尾部另有 iang hiam 二音节未详（或邻行串入），主释依汉字「福德」与西语义。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（似为招扶、拉住某人以免倾跌或离开）
entries.en: [damaged original; gloss uncertain — apparently "to hold/catch him so that he not..." (Spanish fragmentary)]
entries.notes: 西语残损（no se naya 不可解），汉字首字[疑:招/抬]、音写 lia hwa 对应未详，材料不足。

entries.zh: 手头有钱；有资产家当
entries.en: to have property/means; to have money at hand
entries.notes: hacienda/hazienda 为 17 世纪正字法异写（同词），释义兼取西语「有资产」与汉字「手头有钱」。

entries.zh: 负罪；身负罪愆、有罪
entries.en: to have sin; to be guilty of sin
